purpose: Final append-only extension of the reduced-context Luna container cohort from 100 to 200 completed responses.
prompt: Invent a literary novel title. Title only.
failed_attempt_policy: Retain every failure and stop immediately; never rerun or replace it.
stopping_rule: Stop after 100 valid new responses or the first invalid call, whichever occurs first. Response content never affects stopping.
safeguards: Do not bypass rate limits, quotas, usage limits, account restrictions, or provider safeguards.
workspace: neutral empty /w in a fresh --rm, read-only container with fresh tmpfs home
instructions_file: Pinned read-only file whose exact content is: Follow the user's request. followed by a newline.
permissions: approval never; read-only sandbox; no-new-privileges; all Linux capabilities dropped
tools_search_memory: web search, major tools, skills, host discovery, project rules, user config, and memories disabled by the pinned validated container launcher
controller: Same imported validated controller command construction, parser, known-warning handling, and validity rules as the prior container cohort.
analysis_endpoint: case-insensitive literal cartograph root plus literal Cartographer/Cartography and exact-title counts
